name: Fatherless
overview: The Scriptures reveal a compassionate concern for the fatherless, exemplified by the daughters of Zelophehad who sought justice when their father died without sons to inherit his land. Their plea before Moses and the congregation highlights God's provision for those without natural male heirs, ensuring their names and inheritance are preserved. This account underscores the biblical principle that God hears the cries of the fatherless and commands His people to act justly on their behalf.
